t: This is Milton Gate, an office building in the City of London. It was designed by Sir Denys Lasdun, an English architect who has been called the greatest of the early heroic modern period. His most famous work is the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank, one of the most notable examples of Brutalist design in the United Kingdom. Here you can see how he worked on a very different kind of building, in the heart of the City.
